title: 해양경찰위원회 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters necessary for the operation of the Coast Guard Committee and related matters pursuant to Article 10 (3) of the Coast Guard Act.
